client_requirements: control payload is at most 125 bytes
close payload length is zero or at least two
close code is valid and close reason is UTF-8
data opcode matches the negotiated subprotocol

negotiated_encodings.trnm.json.v1: text opcode carrying the strict JSON authority request and response

server_requirements: HTTP upgrade validates version, key and one supported subprotocol
server payload length uses minimal encoding
the same payload and control bounds apply
ping receives pong with identical payload
close is echoed and terminates the connection
read timeout terminates with going-away close when delivery remains possible
the connection closes after at most 64 received messages
all data frames reach the same post-commit authority application path
not_implemented: official Nakama realtime protobuf messages or envelopes
session expiry and revocation disconnect fanout
distributed route registry and cross-node fanout
